title: Chapter 67 Country People Enter The City
content:
Chapter 67 Country People Enter The City

"How is this possible?!!"

Emperor Ming was in disbelief.

That was the ancient divine gold, not some broken stone that was everywhere.

Although he said he didn't believe it, Emperor Ming couldn't wait to come to the city wall and couldn't help but touch it.

"This, this, this, really, this is all the ancient divine gold!"

On the side, Li Changyue's face was extremely solemn.

To build such a huge city with such a big hand, what is the mentality of the owner of this huge city?

Does he really regard money as dirt?

However, at this time, Li Changyue stared at Emperor Ming in front of the city wall with wide eyes, and saw that Emperor Ming had taken out a pickaxe from somewhere and swung it directly.

"Fuck!"

"Chief, calm down!"

Seeing this scene, several members of the Undead Emperor Clan hurried forward to hold Emperor Ming.

After a while, Emperor Ming finally regained his sanity.

Looking at the ancient divine gold on the entire wall in front of him, Emperor Ming's heart was bleeding.

Dig a piece, dig a piece.

And at this moment, An Xing appeared in front of the city gate.

"Please, everyone."

Hearing this, everyone outside the city hurriedly looked at An Xing.

Heavenly King Realm.

Suddenly, everyone narrowed their eyes slightly.

This deserted city deserves to be called the strongest force in the current Wanling Realm.

Anyone sent out at random actually has the strength of the Heavenly Realm.

And on the city wall, they also clearly know that there is a strong man in the Heavenly King Realm, and he is also a sword cultivator.

The deserted city is indeed full of crouching tigers and hidden dragons.

Then the people of the two tribes did not dare to be careless, and hurriedly thanked An Xing and followed him into the deserted city.

"Ga~"

As soon as they entered the deserted city, they saw the scenes in front of them.

Whether it was the people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan or the Undead Emperor Clan, they all stood there in a daze as if struck by lightning.

It was seen that the entire city was made of ancient divine gold, and many more rare materials were mixed in it.

It's so luxurious!

If I could live in such a place in this life, I would have no regrets even if I died!

At this time, Li Changyue noticed a stream in the city, and he stopped immediately.

"Patriarch, what's wrong with you?"

Seeing Li Changyue's abnormality, several people from the Immortal Clan hurried over.

On the side, the people from the Undead Emperor Clan also frowned slightly.

Emperor Ming quickly restrained the shock on his face, then coughed lightly and said sarcastically: "Hehe, the Immortal Clan, who still calls themselves immortals, are just a group of guys who have never seen the world."

However, Emperor Ming couldn't help but walk slowly to the stream out of curiosity.

Well, this stream is not bad.

Oh wait, this, this, this! ?

Good fortune nectar!

No, no, no, it's impossible, I must have seen it wrong.

This is the nectar of nature, how can it possibly flow into a river?

However, the refreshing aura of direction cannot deceive people.

Seeing that the people of the two tribes all stopped in front of the stream, An Xing hurried over.

"Sir, what is this river?"

Li Changyue said in a daze.

Hearing this, An Xing said in a calm voice: "Oh, this, this is just a small river in the city. The residents usually get their daily water from this river."

"What!"

"You mean, everyone in your city uses this water."

"Yes."

Suddenly, the people of the two tribes all stopped talking.

They were a little confused at this moment.

So luxurious?

In comparison, they seemed like country people who came to the city for the first time.

No, at this moment they were a group of country people who came to the city for the first time.

"Well, can I take some back?"

At this time, Di Ming said cautiously.

Hearing this, the others also looked at An Xing, with expectant eyes, waiting for An Xing's answer.

At this time, An Xing looked at these people with pity.

Alas, they are all a bunch of pitiful people.

"Haha, fellow Taoist, you are joking. It's just a little water. You can take it as you like."

As soon as the voice fell, the people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan and the Undead Emperor Clan all took out their tools and began to absorb it frantically.

"Fuck, go over there, you sucked up all the water."

"Hey, don't grab it, I don't have any water."

For a while, the two clans almost fought over the water.

And the people in the city also noticed the movement here and surrounded them.

"This guy, what are they doing?"

A bystander asked An Xing.

Hearing this, An Xing explained: "Alas, they are just some poor people who have never seen good water. Let them take it."

Hearing this, everyone looked at the people of the two tribes with pity.

They are so ungrateful. There are so many poor people in the outside world who have never even drunk water.

Then, everyone took out the water from their homes and handed it to Li Changyue, Di Ming and others.

Among them, there was even some food.

"Huh?"

Suddenly, the people of the two tribes were a little confused.

What is this for.

Why are they looking at them like this.

"Huh, these guys treat us as beggars, tribe leader, let me teach them a lesson."

As he said, a member of the Undead Emperor Clan was about to step forward and take action.

However, Di Ming stopped him.

I saw Di Ming staring at the food given to them, and his expression suddenly brightened.

The next moment, Di Ming picked up a fruit and took a bite.

Sweet and refreshing.

But this is not the most important thing. The most important thing is that the state of Emperor Ming, which has been silent for a long time, has begun to loosen up.

Although it is very weak, it is already very amazing.

You know, he is a strong man in the realm of destiny.

And he is not an ordinary strong man in the realm of destiny.

"This is a good thing!"

The people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan on the side also noticed this quickly.

Then, the people of the two clans no longer cared about the strange eyes of the crowd, and took whatever they gave.

"Hahahaha, I'm rich, I'm rich."

Just when the people of the two clans were excited, a group of people came here.

Seeing this, the onlookers quickly retreated to the side.

Huang Wei.

I saw the leader holding a long knife in his hand, looking at Li Changyue, Emperor Ming and others and said coldly: "Begging is prohibited in the city!"

.........

After some small episodes, the two clans finally came to the city lord's mansion and entered the hall.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had been waiting for a long time.

Seeing these people, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but joked: "It seems that you all like my Desolate City very much?"

Hearing this, the people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan and the Undead Emperor Clan suddenly blushed.

Thinking about it now, it is indeed very out of control.

But there is no way, they can't control themselves.

At this time, Li Changyue coughed lightly and said: "You are the Lord of Desolate City, I am the Clan Leader of the Changsheng Immortal Clan."

Emperor Ming also said: "I am the Clan Leader of the Undead Emperor Clan."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said: "I already know all this, tell me, the purpose of your coming to see me."

Suddenly, the two people's eyelids jumped.

Li Changyue secretly glanced at Emperor Ming, and seeing that the other party did not speak, he directly said: "Lord of Desolate City, do you know why the human race suddenly disappeared back then?"

Lu Daosheng nodded and said: "I know."

Hearing this, Li Changyue continued: "Lord of Desolate City, I came here to tell you, huh? What?"

Know?

For a moment, Li Changyue was a little dumbfounded.

The other party actually knew.

Why?

Could it be? !

Suddenly, countless possibilities appeared in Li Changyue's mind.

At this time, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "You want to ask, why do I dare to rebuild the human race's power, why am I so high-profile?"

Hearing this, Li Changyue and Di Ming nodded at the same time.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng continued to smile and said, "Why do you think I dare?"
